title: Blockbuster's 9,000-Store Empire Disappeared
hook: Blockbuster's 9,000-store empire vanished as movies moved home.
closing: Even giants can disappear when convenience rewires everyday habits.
question: Did you ever rent from Blockbuster?

segments.say: Netflix mail subscribers reached 12.3 million. Home delivery removed the trip that Blockbuster depended on.
Blockbuster once operated 9,000 stores. The giant's physical network became its weakness.
Only 1 Blockbuster store remained. A global chain became a single survivor.
